title: Evergreen clone PageSpec
description: The machine contract for a generated page. Closed template enum, closed section enum, closed per-section content, closed motion object, closed assetRole enum, additionalProperties:false throughout. Structural rules JSON Schema cannot express (node sequence vs declared template, rhythm rules, per-instance maxWords) are enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py — BOTH must pass.
